features.name: OnBase connector (fixture mode)
features.description: Reads OnBase Studio export packages (.expk), a sample schema.json, and parsed workflow JSON so the whole pipeline works end-to-end without any live OnBase credentials.
features.notes: Application/sources/onbase.py — mode=auto|live|fixture; 6 .expk exports + workflow JSON present as fixtures

features.name: Live OnBase REST integration
features.description: Pull document types, keyword types, lifecycles, and document binaries directly from a running OnBase deployment via the Public REST API.
features.notes: OnBaseRestClient is a stub (M2). Methods exist but are not yet exercised against a live host

features.name: Live OnBase Unity integration
features.description: Reach Unity-only capabilities (dashboards, lifecycle definitions) the REST API doesn't expose, via a .NET shim or REST overlap.
features.notes: UnityClient raises NotImplementedError (M3)

features.name: Secure OnBase sign-in (OAuth2 PKCE)
features.description: Authenticate to the institution's identity provider so CogniBase can act as the signed-in user against OnBase.
features.notes: auth config shape exists in settings.example.json; AuthManager wiring pending (M2)

features.name: Natural-language Q&A over OnBase data
features.description: Ask a question in plain English; CogniBase retrieves the most relevant anchored records and an AI vendor answers, citing the sources it used.
features.notes: POST /chat → QueryEngine (retrieve → synthesize). 503s clearly if no index/embed vendor is configured

features.name: Local vector search
features.description: All anchored data is embedded into a private, on-disk vector store so semantic search never leaves the machine.
features.notes: ChromaDB PersistentClient at Product/ONBASE/RAG_Index — ~40 demo embeddings today

features.name: Vendor-neutral LLM choice
features.description: Pick which AI answers — Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, or a local model (Ollama / LM Studio / llama.cpp) — with no code change and no lock-in.
features.notes: VendorRouter prefer→default→first-active; Claude active by default, others pre-wired/off

features.name: Source-cited answers
features.description: Every answer lists the record ids and metadata it drew from, so a human can verify the AI rather than trust it blindly.
features.notes: QueryEngine returns citations[] with id, metadata, similarity score

features.name: Anchors — scoped data slices
features.description: Define exactly which slice of OnBase data a question may touch (a doc type, keyword set, or lifecycle); the AI can never read outside it.
features.notes: Anchor model + file-backed registry; materializer writes raw JSONL + per-anchor Chroma collection

features.name: Workspaces
features.description: Group several anchors and bridges into a named working set the AI reasons across.
features.notes: Workspace dataclass + WorkspaceRegistry (JSON-backed)

features.name: Semantic Bridges (un-silo BU prefixes)
features.description: Automatically suggest where the same field/group lives under different department prefixes (ADM_, HR_, FIN_, IST_…) so a single query can span silos.
features.notes: bridges/suggester.py — prefix-strip + root match + calibrated confidence tiers (0.55–0.95)

features.name: Entity resolution across sources
features.description: Recognise that records from different silos refer to the same person/vendor and cluster them.
features.notes: entities/resolver.py built + tested (deterministic + fuzzy); not yet wired into the materializer pipeline

features.name: Author a capability
features.description: An admin describes the question once; it becomes a reusable, parameterized tile (a retrieval or a report) instead of ad-hoc SQL spread across spreadsheets.
features.notes: POST /capabilities + Capability model; JSON is the source of truth (no DB migrations)

features.name: Safe-SQL gate
features.description: Before any capability can be published or run, its SQL is parsed and rejected unless it is a single read-only SELECT that touches only its declared anchors.
features.notes: capabilities/validator.py via sqlglot — blocks writes/DDL/PRAGMA/system tables/out-of-anchor tables; runs at publish AND run time

features.name: Publish & grant to groups
features.description: Published tiles are explicitly granted to CogniBase Groups; nothing is visible to a user without a grant.
features.notes: CapabilityGrant; grant/revoke endpoints; clone_allowed off by default

features.name: AI capability drafter
features.description: Turn an admin's plain-English intent into a candidate capability (SQL + parameters) to edit and save.
features.notes: capabilities/drafter.py is a heuristic stub today; LLM-assisted drafting planned

features.name: Audit summary on every run
features.description: Each capability run produces a Word document recording who ran what, with which parameters, against which data snapshot, and the rows returned — reproducible byte-for-byte.
features.notes: generate_audit_summary() pins capability version + snapshot; .docx + .json sidecar per run (M48)

features.name: Capability tiles in Retrieval & Reports
features.description: End-users see the tiles their group is allowed to run, fill in the parameters, and get results — no SQL knowledge required.
features.notes: GET /capabilities/for-group powers the user-facing tabs (rendered in the React mockup)

features.name: Templated .docx reports
features.description: Generate reports from .docx templates and reproduce OnBase Unity Client dashboards.
features.notes: reports/template_engine.py + dashboard_repro.py scaffolded; live dashboard reproduction needs the Unity client (M11–M13)

features.name: Lifecycle visualizer
features.description: Render an OnBase workflow lifecycle as a diagram whose nodes scale with how populated each state is.
features.notes: GET /visualizer/lifecycle/{file}/{num}.svg — pure-SVG, population-scaled (M25-minimal); full AI-driven canvas planned (M25)

features.name: Standalone retrieval UI (OnBase Web Client look-alike)
features.description: A web UI that mimics the OnBase retrieval experience, decoupled from any installed OnBase client.
features.notes: Today the server serves DESIGN/mockup.html; the real UI is M10

features.name: Portable install
features.description: Run via Docker, a pip editable install, or a direct clone — all persistent state lives in bind-mounted folders so the whole tool can move machines.
features.notes: Dockerfile + docker-compose.yml + pyproject (cognibase-server entry point)

features.name: Registered in the QI ecosystem
features.description: Listed in qi_registry.json with a port block (8650-8659), GitHub repo, and a named Cloudflare tunnel reserved.
features.notes: id=cognibase, status=pre_poc; tunnel cognibase.quiddityinnovations.com reserved

features.name: Run 24/7 as a Windows service
features.description: Run CogniBase and its public tunnel as managed Windows services so they survive reboots.
features.notes: QI_CogniBase + QI_CogniBaseTunnel documented in QI_Service_Registry.md but not yet installed/running

features.name: QI module interface contract (/health, /version, /info)
features.description: Expose the standard liveness/identity/self-description endpoints every QI project must implement.
features.notes: Only GET /health exists today; /version and /info still to be added
